component_roles.cache_or_idempotency_index: Reuses or proves equality for identical requests under identical authorities.
component_roles.dataset_registry: Registers generated outputs by request fingerprint, status, coverage, hashes and restrictions.
component_roles.execution_planner: Produces a plan with partitions, estimated rows, validators, limits and output mode before build.
component_roles.materializer: Builds requested data only after separate execution authorization.
component_roles.profile_resolver: Verifies official semantic profile status and compatible versions.
component_roles.request_contract: Defines what is being asked, under which profile, universe, dates, output mode and authority.
component_roles.source_resolver: Resolves governed physical source authority and coverage, without inventing data truth.
component_roles.validator: Checks schema, lineage, temporal legality, determinism and scope compliance.

definition.capability_not_dataset: A capability may exist before any official physical dataset exists; it defines how one may be generated under authorization.
definition.request: The primary runtime object. Market State and Event State become request types, not ad hoc parquet-building tasks.
definition.runtime_capability: A governed TSIS ability to resolve a request into sources, profiles, execution plan, deterministic build, validation evidence, registry entry and reproducible output when separately authorized.
